source: made up: traveler with a 3 PM flight juggling a morning work meeting, packing, and airport logistics
persona: Liam, a management consultant flying to Denver at 15:00 for a long weekend wedding. Texts briskly and methodically, works a half-day in the morning, and insists on arriving at the airport 2 hours before boarding—which means leaving the apartment in an Uber by 12:15.
situation: Thursday morning at 07:00. Working a morning half-day 08:30–11:30 with a 09:30 client readout, hasn't finished packing his garment bag or carry-on yet, needs to drop his house keys with his neighbor for plant watering, and has a 15:00 flight out of the main terminal.
life: 07:05 Wake up and text the app: flying to Denver today at 15:00! Working 08:30–11:30 this morning (client readout at 09:30), and I MUST be in an Uber to the airport by 12:15. Before 12:15 I need to shower & eat breakfast, steam my suit and finish packing my carry-on, prep the slide deck for 09:30, take out the kitchen trash and perishables, drop my spare keys with neighbor Mrs. Gable, and grab a quick lunch.
07:10 If the app puts steaming the suit or packing after 12:15, remind it that 12:15 is my hard Uber departure time for the 15:00 flight.
07:15 Shower, make coffee and eggs, and start steaming the navy suit for the wedding until 08:25.
08:28 Report shower, breakfast, and suit steaming done. Logging into work now to finalize the client readout slides before 09:30.
08:30 Polish the executive summary slides and check data tables until 09:30.
09:30 Present the client readout on Zoom; client asks for an extra sensitivity table to be emailed before you head to the airport, keeping you on the call until 10:35.
10:38 Text the app: client call ran 5 mins over and I need 35 minutes right now to run and send an extra Excel sensitivity table before I can log off! Push packing my carry-on to 11:15.
10:40 Run the Excel sensitivity numbers and send the follow-up email to the client partner, logging off work at 11:15.
11:18 Report client email sent and out-of-office auto-reply turned on! Packing carry-on and toiletries now.
11:20 Pack suit, dress shoes, chargers, and toiletries into the carry-on roller, then clear old milk and greens out of the fridge until 11:50.
11:52 Knock on neighbor Mrs. Gable's door to hand over the spare keys—she asks you to show her which fern needs misting, taking until 12:08.

12:10 Text the app: keys handed off and trash goes down the chute on my way to the elevator! Didn't have time to make lunch at home—calling the Uber right now and I'll grab a sandwich past TSA security.
12:15 Take the Uber to the airport, clear TSA PreCheck at 13:05, and buy a turkey club and water bottle near Gate B14, eating until 13:50.
13:55 Text the app from the gate: through security and ate lunch at the terminal! Going to spend 30 minutes downloading podcasts and cleaning out my personal email inbox before boarding at 14:25.
13:55 Download flight podcasts and clear personal inbox at the gate until 14:25.
14:25 Board the 15:00 flight to Denver (lands at 19:15 local / 21:15 home time).
21:30 Check into the Denver hotel, unpack the suit so it doesn't wrinkle, and grab a late bite with college friends in the hotel bar until 23:00.
constraints: Hard departure in an Uber to the airport at 12:15 for the 15:00 flight.
All home tasks (steaming suit, packing carry-on, emptying fridge perishables, dropping spare keys with neighbor, taking out trash) must be completed before 12:15.
Client follow-up sensitivity table must be emailed before turning on out-of-office at 11:15.

truth.item: Send client Excel sensitivity table & set OOO
Drop keys with Mrs. Gable & take out trash
Uber to airport, TSA & terminal lunch
Download podcasts & clear inbox at gate

profile.Travel: Always leaves for the airport 2h 45m before domestic flights.

notes.title: Denver Wedding Trip Prep
notes.body:
## Before 12:15 PM Uber
- [ ] Steam navy suit & pack garment folder
- [ ] Pack carry-on (dress shoes, belt, toiletries, chargers)
- [ ] Empty fridge perishables & take trash down chute
- [ ] Give spare keys to Mrs. Gable (4B) for plant watering
- [x] Mobile check-in for UA 1482

## At Airport / Gate
- [ ] Download 3 episodes of Acquired podcast for plane
- [ ] Clear personal email inbox

notes.body:
- [ ] Finalize executive summary slides before 9:30 AM
- [ ] Send follow-up deliverables & turn on OOO auto-responder

notes.body:
